shortTitle: Going to UITH or the colleges? How to get there
title: Getting to UITH and the Old / New College
body: UITH and the Old and New College sites are not on the Main Campus, so you cannot walk there. Take a cab to a motor park in town and continue to your destination from there. Ilorin has several motor parks, so ask which one serves the place you are going.
tips: Board only at recognised motor parks — the state government is cracking down on illegal roadside parks.
It is a trip across town, not across campus — leave extra time, especially before a lecture or exam.
Agree the fare with the driver before you get in.
Tell the driver the exact name: "UITH", "Old College" or "New College".
known: On campus, the new park is near the Gate and the Fountain Roundabout (university buses, reported at ₦100 to campus, late 2025).
Tanke Terminus to campus was reported at ₦200 (late 2025).
note: Not yet confirmed: which motor park serves UITH, the Old College or the New College, the route, and current fares. To be checked on the field trip.
